posts.name: Rishab Panwar
posts.cooked:
@Subendu @sayan

I request the course team to please turn off the monetization from the System Commands youtube channel.
Ads are ok. But too much ads breaks the flow of learning.

Please note that ads in the videos occur every 5 min. That been said I have to watch atleast 1 ad or sometimes 2 ads every minute . It disrupts the learning experience. So, for a 2 hour long video I will be interrupted 24 times and each time I have to watch 1 or 2 ads.

Regards,
Rishab

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Monetization is not turned on in the channel. Youtube will display ads regardless on videos even if the videos are not monetized by the creator.

Please use an adblocker in your browser for a better quaility-of-life experience.

posts.name: Pulkit Mangal
posts.cooked: It is new YouTube policy to show ads even when the monetization is off. Better to use any adblocker if you are using Chrome or use Brave.

posts.name: 22f2000912
posts.cooked:
Dear sir, @PulkitMangal
ads can be stopped following way.

  1. First apply for Monetization. After approval ads control will be in your hand.
  2. Then Select all videos and follow steps shown in video.
  3. https://youtu.be/TfkcQs2omfE?si=3f2WhZb9cZRa5vLe

This will be a great help to us sir. Ads really disturb study.

posts.name: Johnson Philips
posts.cooked:
If you play the video from within the course portal and maximise the video player window, I believe this will help , in this way I never got a single ad so far -

maybe the ads are coming when you play it from youtube app or website outside the course portal…
that’s my 2 cents, hope it helps…
